policy: Raw third-party datasets are stored beside CCF and are not relicensed under the project MIT license. Derived corpus/gold/KG artifacts required for the demo are included under CCF/data.

CMeIE-V1.purpose: CMeIE-V1 train/dev strict SPO benchmark and public comparison

CMeIE-V2.purpose: Primary GPLinker training, held-out evaluation and schema

DIAKG.purpose: Diabetes-domain corpus, nested terms and relation supervision

CM3KG.purpose: Canonical entity index and imported demonstration KG baseline
